scope: Native issue/pull reads: requested body plus bounded public discussion capture

capture_notes: Capture note: this is the issue body plus a bounded public comment capture, not a complete issue-history export (timeline events, reactions, edits and hidden/deleted comments are not included).

capture_counts: Conversation comments: captured 14 of 14 (1 page(s), per_page 100, body cap 4000 chars per item); complete for this endpoint.
